function.description: Fetches the real-time and historical stock data for Indian equities from NSE or BSE.

symbol.description: The ticker symbol of the Indian equity, e.g. RELIANCE, SUZLON, TCS.

exchange.description: The exchange to query. Defaults to NSE.
